format: Perl with embedded assembly (x86 assembly code)
description: This file contains Perl code that generates optimized x86 assembly implementations of the ChaCha20 stream cipher, including SSSE3-accelerated routines, for performance benchmarking and cryptographic operations.

methods.name: QUARTERROUND
methods.description: Performs a quarter-round operation used in the ChaCha20 cipher, manipulating state variables with XOR, addition, rotation, and data movement.

methods.name: SSSE3ROUND
methods.description: Performs a round of the SSSE3-accelerated ChaCha20 quarter-round operations using SIMD instructions.
